testimonials.name: Vikram Rathore
testimonials.reviewText: The curriculum is exceptionally modern. My son Kabir is actually building web tools and programming microcontrollers instead of just learning theoretical terms. Saurabh sir's background makes a huge difference.

testimonials.name: Rohan Gupta
testimonials.reviewText: The classes here are amazing. Instead of memorizing codes, we learn how to use Cursor AI and prompt engineering to design actual working websites. I built a fully functional weather app in just three classes!

testimonials.name: Meera Patel
testimonials.reviewText: Highly impressed by the mentor. The small batch size of 12 ensures that my son gets individual attention. The syllabus goes way beyond normal computer coaching—they are learning genuine future-ready AI automations.
